title: Engineering authoring guidance
description: Select and explain applicable canonical authoring guidance and assess it against prepared semantic authoring outcomes.
responsibilities: Select guidance applicable to the activity and declared profile.
Explain bounded authoring and correction steps without replacing canonical rules.
Assess prepared authoring tasks using their observable semantic outcomes.

Contribute canonical guidance selection and authoring/correction explanation through FUNC-032/FUNC-033 to MOD-017's IF-008 contract. Preserve adopted profile applicability, source meaning, examples versus rules, and unsupported scope for MOD-012's specialist composition.
owned_state: Guidance applicability selections and prepared task assessment context; canonical rules and actual evidence retain their respective authorities.

includes: Guided authoring, correction, and assessment of guidance usefulness.
excludes: Duplicating canonical metamodel rules, autonomous approval, or manufacturing successful task evidence.

design_limits: IF-008 defines the adopted-REM authoring branch of guidance cooperation with MOD-012. IR-006 ARs, guidance usefulness assessment under FUNC-034, and broader metamodel/authoring/assurance interactions remain deferred.
Contract selection does not adopt REM for a project, interpret or migrate its model, authorize mutation, or define all published specialist procedures.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
